verdict:
NO ENTRY AT $6.23, WATCH WITH THE CONDITIONED GATE - and the existing ledger gate turns out to be exactly what blue's remedy prescribes, so the adjudication's main act is keeping it as written.

THE ANCHOR THE TRIAGE BUILT ON IS GONE. The triage's second decisive datum - 'the IFC verified fairness at $5.52 and the tape is 12.9% above it' - fails on both benches' independent routes. Red: $5.52 is a ~5% discount to the $5.81 pre-print close, struck before the Q2 information set existed. Blue's correction (which matters for the KG entry): the IFC signed the SAME DAY as the release with diligence access, so what $5.52 lacks is not information but PURITY - a development-finance buyer purchasing an ESG/policy-covenant package at a conventional placement discount encodes no pure-alpha fair value. Either way: no fairness anchor exists at any price in this record. And the 'closing mechanically pulls toward $5.52' story is structurally dead - the shares are unregistered, IFC and Axian are strategic multi-year holders, and the registration rights are a FUTURE, undated overhang.

WHAT SURVIVES ON THE BEAR SIDE. DAMAGE-ARRIVING stands (same-print FY GMV guide cut 27-32% to 20-30%, Q3 guided 15-25%, supply disruption 'persists into the early third quarter'). The H2 EBITDA crux survives in CONDITIONAL form: the held $25-30M FY loss envelope needs H2 of $5.6-10.6M, reachable only if the Q3 sequential trend holds AND last year's Q4 seasonal step repeats - and that Q4 step is an electronics-heavy Black-Friday peak the company's own disclosure says is supply-impaired (an AI-memory-supercycle input with no company-controlled end date). Red's finding 6 is the best forward-looking piece in the record. On the bull side, blue's OCF convergence (ex-WC Q2 OCF roughly equals adj-EBITDA) softens the serial-diluter read: burn is converging toward the envelope, and pro-forma ~$96M of liquidity buys 6-7 quarters even on the harsher liquidity-delta math. Demand ex-electronics is genuinely accelerating (orders +28% adj, QAC +23% adj, GP margin up on both bases - blue killed red's venue-divergence flag on the 59% figure, it derives from the release itself).

GATE RULING (the reason this closes clean): the ledger's deck-provisional gate - alert_below 5.5, gate_basis 'reopen court only if decline is not caused by thesis-worsening news (Q3 miss, FX devaluation, supply-shortage extension)' - is PRECISELY blue's doctrinally-complete remedy: CLSK/WYFI doctrine disarms BARE gates; it permits a conditioned gate with an adjudicated basis. JMIA's carriers are African FX (NGN/EGP) and the memory-shortage cycle; the gate text already excludes fills caused by either. Keep it verbatim, now court-adjudicated rather than deck-provisional. No resting order - the gate triggers a re-court, not a fill.
blue_ruling: PARTIALLY OVERTURNED: blue AFFIRMED red's reject-at-the-tape (the $5.52 'verified-fair' anchor is dead twice over - a pre-print placement discount per red's arithmetic, an impurity-laden development-finance price per blue's correction; either way not a fairness verdict) and SUSTAINED the no-mechanical-supply and self-triggering-gate findings, but REDUCED red's two magnitude claims: the '52% burn wedge' was a liquidity-delta-vs-OCF conflation (Q2 OCF -$11.8M including a $3.0M WC outflow converges toward the -$8.7M adj-EBITDA), and red's H2-arithmetic refutation double-counted - red cannot use last year's Q4 seasonal step to refute the guide-tension AND separately argue the shortage impairs that exact step. Blue also caught red listing its own mind-change trigger (the 08-14 13G/A) as uncheckable when it sat in the pack: Fund 1 Investments' 7.48% is a quarter-end amendment, not post-print buying - and the same filing closes the share-count gap (~123.8M ADS, dilution ~7.3%).
reopen_gates: EVENT (converts the undated overhang into a dated one): the resale registration statement for the IFC/Other-Investor shares filed with the SEC - a dated supply event beats an undated one; re-court on the filing with the effectiveness date in hand.

PRICE (existing ledger gate KEPT VERBATIM, now adjudicated): tape at/below ~$5.50 WITH the gate_basis satisfied - the decline must NOT be caused by a Q3 GMV miss, NGN/EGP devaluation, or supply-shortage extension. A conditioned fill reopens the court; it does not buy anything.

DATA: Q3 OCF confirming the ex-WC convergence blue found (operating cash use tracking adj-EBITDA within ~$3M) - two consecutive quarters of convergence retires the serial-diluter discount and makes the loss envelope the real number.

DATA: Q4 supply normalization language - the crux's failure mode is the electronics peak; a company statement that smartphone supply normalized (or a DRAM-price rollover doing it exogenously) re-opens the H2 arithmetic bullishly before the FY print does.
EVENT: a company PR confirming the Q3 print date (~2026-11-11 is cadence-inferred only) - re-key the pack.
DATA (open cap-structure item both benches carried): converts/warrants from the 20-F equity note - the TENX rule is still unmet; close it before any per-share claim is load-bearing in a future court.
adjudicator_note: batch-6 draft RATIFIED 2026-08-17; every proposed price gate re-checked against the beta-carrier self-trigger rule before arming (LTBR anchor self-updates on net cash; LAC carries NO bare price gate; RBLX/INTR/JMIA gates kept as review-only triggers, never entries)
